iterations.arithmetic: 10 - 0 (no beat missing) - 0 (no beat out of order) = 10

beats.note: All three sub-actions present: the third entry, the Drowned Page line in Ada's hand, Creed's countersignature beneath it.

beats.quote: Ada stood with her left cuff black to the elbow and let him count.
"Off the seventh step," Ada said. "The petitions. I copy the name and enter it within the hour, in my hand, at a bearing I choose."
Creed did not offer a reason. Neither did she.
Creed took the pen from her and countersigned beneath the line.
"*Marigold*," Nell said, once, aloud, over the water.
